scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You want a Solution? Hmm, give me 50 Zeny and at least 1 Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你想要藥水嗎？嗯，給我50 Zeny和至少1個空試管。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey! You don't have enough money to cover my 50 Zeny charge.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嘿！你的錢不夠支付我50 Zeny的費用。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can't carry solutions without a bottle! Bring me an Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
沒有瓶子你沒法裝藥水！給我帶一個空試管來。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Would you like a Solution? Then please give me 50 Zeny and at least 1 Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你想要藥水嗎？請給我50 Zeny和至少1個空試管。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money to cover the 50 Zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
很抱歉，你的錢不夠支付50 Zeny的費用。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can't carry liquids without using a bottle. Bring an Empty Test Tube the next time you see me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
沒有瓶子你沒法裝液體。下次見到我時請帶一個空試管來。
